description: Source code for a Bluetooth Mesh Blob Server implementation in Zephyr OS, handling transfer states, chunk management, and message handling.

methods.name: block_count_get
methods.description: Calculates the total number of blocks based on transfer size and block size log.

methods.name: max_chunk_size
methods.description: Determines the maximum chunk size based on MTU and protocol overhead.

methods.name: max_chunk_count
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of chunks per block.

methods.name: missing_chunks
methods.description: Counts the number of missing chunks in a block.

methods.name: store_state
methods.description: Stores the current transfer state persistently if settings are enabled.

methods.name: erase_state
methods.description: Erases the stored transfer state.

methods.name: io_open
methods.description: Opens the IO stream for transfer.

methods.name: io_close
methods.description: Closes the IO stream for transfer.

methods.name: reset_timer
methods.description: Reschedules the timeout timer based on transfer mode.

methods.name: buf_chunk_index_add
methods.description: Encodes a chunk index into a buffer using UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: pull_req_max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of pull requests based on power mode and queue size.

methods.name: report_sent
methods.description: Callback invoked after a report message is sent, possibly triggers LPN poll.

methods.name: block_report
methods.description: Sends a block report message with missing chunks.

methods.name: phase_set
methods.description: Sets the current transfer phase.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current transfer, resets state, and notifies callback.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the transfer, cancels timers, and notifies callback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended transfer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Completes the transfer, cleans up, and notifies callback.

methods.name: all_blocks_received
methods.description: Checks if all blocks have been received.

methods.name: pull_mode_xfer_complete
methods.description: Checks if a pull mode transfer is complete.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Handles transfer timeout, cancels or suspends transfer based on phase.

methods.name: report_timeout
methods.description: Handles report timeout, triggers block report.

methods.name: xfer_status_rsp
methods.description: Sends transfer status response message.

methods.name: block_status_rsp
methods.description: Sends block status response message.

methods.name: handle_xfer_get
methods.description: Handles transfer get message, responds with current transfer status.

methods.name: handle_xfer_start
methods.description: Handles transfer start message, initializes transfer parameters.

methods.name: handle_xfer_cancel
methods.description: Handles transfer cancel message, aborts transfer.

methods.name: handle_block_get
methods.description: Handles block get message, responds with block status.

methods.name: handle_block_start
methods.description: Handles block start message, prepares for data chunks.

methods.name: handle_chunk
methods.description: Handles incoming data chunk, writes to storage, updates missing chunks.

methods.name: handle_info_get
methods.description: Handles info get message, responds with transfer parameters.

methods.name: blob_srv_init
methods.description: Initializes the blob server model.

methods.name: blob_srv_settings_set
methods.description: Restores transfer state from persistent storage.

methods.name: blob_srv_start
methods.description: Starts or recovers a transfer session.

methods.name: blob_srv_reset
methods.description: Resets the server to inactive state.
